entities.summary: Sara Karin Maria Grahn is a Swedish ice hockey goaltender for Luleå HF/MSSK in the Swedish Women's Hockey League and the Swedish national team. She is the longest tenured goaltender in SDHL history, the only one to have ever played more than 300 games, and has won the SDHL championship five times.
